ai_summary: Allcargo Global Limited's October 2026 operational update indicates a challenging month, marked by significant year-on-year volume declines of 13% in FCL and 3% in LCL operations, primarily due to geopolitical issues and easing peak season demand. While Air operations grew 4% year-on-year and LCL container utilization improved, the substantial FCL volume contraction linked to external instability presents a material impact and a key red flag regarding market vulnerability.
